description:
Latest GPU rental price index families, in US dollars per GPU-hour.

Call this for the current index level of a GPU model in one market segment. Omit model for every model. Pass one model name for that model only.

Each family is one model, one segment (HYP hyperscaler, PUBNEO public neocloud, PRIVNEO private neocloud, MKT marketplace), and one price class (OD on-demand, MK marketplace ask, SP spot), with id IG.<GPU>.<SEGMENT>.<CLASS>. Segments are never combined, and no cross-segment figure is returned. A published family has median_usd_per_gpu_hour, p25_usd_per_gpu_hour, p75_usd_per_gpu_hour, and providers; it needs at least 3 providers after a 3-MAD filter. Any other family has status and providers only. Unknown model: {"error": "not_found", "query", "models": [names]}.

model.description: GPU model name as published, for example H100 SXM. Empty returns every model.

response_format.description: markdown (default) is a compact reading form. json is the object described below, with source numbers and omitted fields left out.

name: gpu_price_index
